frequency.docs:
**frequency**: Set the frequency the I²C bus should operate on. Defaults to `50kHz`. Values are `10kHz`, `50kHz`, `100kHz`, `200kHz`, ... `800kHz`.

*See also: [I²C Bus](https://esphome.io/components/i2c#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID for this I²C bus if you need multiple I²C buses.

*See also: [I²C Bus](https://esphome.io/components/i2c#configuration-variables)*

low_power_mode.docs:
**boolean**: Enable the low-power (master only) I²C bus. Only available on ESP32C5, ESP32C6 and ESP32P4. Defaults to `false` unless required.

*See also: [I²C Bus](https://esphome.io/components/i2c#configuration-variables)*

scan.docs:
**boolean**: If ESPHome should do a search of the I²C address space on startup. Defaults to `true`.

*See also: [I²C Bus](https://esphome.io/components/i2c#configuration-variables)*

scl.docs:
**[Pin](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin)**: The pin for the clock line of the I²C bus. Defaults to the default of your board (usually GPIO22 for ESP32 and GPIO5 for ESP8266).

*See also: [I²C Bus](https://esphome.io/components/i2c#configuration-variables)*

scl_pullup_enabled.docs:
**boolean**: Enable the internal pullup resistor for the SCL pin. Defaults to `true`.

*See also: [I²C Bus](https://esphome.io/components/i2c#configuration-variables)*

sda.docs:
**[Pin](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin)**: The pin for the data line of the I²C bus. Defaults to the default of your board (usually GPIO21 for ESP32 and GPIO4 for ESP8266).

*See also: [I²C Bus](https://esphome.io/components/i2c#configuration-variables)*

sda_pullup_enabled.docs:
**boolean**: Enable the internal pullup resistor for the SDA pin. Defaults to `true`.

*See also: [I²C Bus](https://esphome.io/components/i2c#configuration-variables)*

timeout.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: Set the I²C bus timeout. Defaults to the framework defaults (`100us` on `esp32`, `1s` on `esp8266` and `1s` on `rp2040`). Maximum on `esp32` is 13ms.

*See also: [I²C Bus](https://esphome.io/components/i2c#configuration-variables)*
